svg.text: From evidence to complaint — where the user stays in control
Teal = plain code. Wheat = the user decides. Slate = optional AI that can only draft.
Each visit is a record with
Who is in charge at each step
Entitlement maths, labels, report and complaint wording,
neutrality and Aadhaar checks. Works offline. AI is never
Confirms the rule, confirms every machine reading, listens to
the complaint before copying it, and submits it on the
Reads photos, voice and regional-language text, and
translates. Always returns a draft with a confidence level;
What happens to a photo of a slip
If the photo is unclear the user is asked to retake it. Nothing is guessed, and the unmasked original never reaches disk or any AI service.
Hosted AI, if allowed, receives the masked image from step 5 — not the original.
